description: This Java class `DefaultMqttConfig` implements the `MqttConfig` interface, providing configuration settings related to MQTT such as buffer size, loaded from a configuration object. It offers methods for creation from a config, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultMqttConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MQTT configuration, specifically buffer size, constructed from a scoped configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultMqttConfig from a Typesafe Config object, applying fallback and default values.

methods.name: getSourceBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the configured source buffer size for MQTT.
